notes: REF-BM-02: fetcher extracts only title/description; favicon is a letter placeholder (not fetched) and preview image is never collected. REF-BM-03: title/description editable only after saving via edit dialog; save auto-collects immediately with no pre-save form, so no editing before saving. REF-BM-11: no clickable tag-filter affordance (chips only untag); filtering to a single tag is reachable only via #tag search. REF-BM-12: haystack searches title/desc/note/host/tags but not the full URL path, so url is only partially searched. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no persisted display settings (font size, displayed items); sort is session-only and not saved as a preference.
